WITH fee_by_order AS (
  SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate, AVG(rebrate) AS avg_rebate_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
scope_stats AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.avg_fee_rate - f.avg_rebate_rate) AS avg_rate_diff, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM fee_by_order AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_diff) AS avg_scope_diff
  FROM scope_stats
)
SELECT s.acctscope, s.avg_rate_diff, s.record_count, s.avg_rate_diff - a.avg_scope_diff
FROM scope_stats AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS a
WHERE a.avg_scope_diff IS NOT NULL
